description: The shared winlog derived layer. Runs after a source submodule (windowlicker's goevtx, log2timeline's winevtx) has mapped its native shape onto the canonical winlog.* model, so it is lane-agnostic: it reads winlog.* and winlog.data.* and projects the event onto ECS (event.*, log.level, user.*, source.*, destination.*, process.*), then dispatches to the per-channel pipeline for the channel-specific extractions. The native winlog.* fields are left in place. The base block here is what applies to every channel: event.kind/code/provider, the Level->log.level rendering, the Level->event.severity bucket (inline), and the EventID->message enrichment via the windows-signature enrich policy (elastic/enrich/). The lookups without a clean ECS home (reason, privilege names, task category) are not projected; their raw inputs stay in winlog.*.

script.description: EVTX Level -> ECS log.level, the way Windows renders it (1 critical, 2 error, 3 warning, 4 information, 5 verbose; 0 is LogAlways/undefined -> information)
script.source: def m = ['0':'information','1':'critical','2':'error','3':'warning','4':'information','5':'verbose']; def n = m.get(String.valueOf(ctx.winlog.level)); if (n != null) { if (!(ctx.log instanceof Map)) { ctx.log = [:]; } ctx.log.level = n; }

script.description: severity bucket from the Level -> ECS event.severity (critical 4, high 3, medium 2, informational 1); inline 6-row Level-to-severity map
script.source: def m = ['0':1,'1':4,'2':3,'3':2,'4':1,'5':1]; def n = m.get(String.valueOf(ctx.winlog.level)); if (n != null) { if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } ctx.event.severity = n; }

enrich.description: EventID -> the event's human-readable description, via the windows-signature enrich policy. The policy must exist at pipeline-create time; see elastic/enrich/README.md.

set.description: ECS message from the signature description, only when the record carries none of its own (Plaso's message is left intact)

script.description: build the composite key for the reason lookup (signature_id|status|substatus, hex lowercased) when the record carries a Status
script.if: ctx.winlog?.event_id != null && ctx.winlog?.data instanceof Map && ctx.winlog.data.Status instanceof String && ctx.winlog.data.Status.length() > 0
script.source: def st = ctx.winlog.data.Status; def sub = ctx.winlog.data.SubStatus; def subk = (sub instanceof String && sub.length() > 0) ? sub.toLowerCase() : st.toLowerCase(); ctx._tmp_rkey = ctx.winlog.event_id + '|' + st.toLowerCase() + '|' + subk;

enrich.description: failed-logon reason via the windows-reason enrich policy

set.description: fall back to the event's own Computer for host.name when the parent lane did not set one
set.if: ctx.host?.name == null && ctx.winlog?.computer instanceof String && ctx.winlog.computer.length() > 0
